changelog: Dialer: a lead whose number already has a Roofr job made since the lead came in is never dialed (it was booked outside the dialer). The server closes those rows as Booked.
Dialer: an existing customer calling about their job gets one callback. Before it, the dialer pauses and shows the job, its stage and a link, with Dial now or Skip.
Dialer: if someone already talked to this number since the lead came in, the dialer pauses and shows who, when and for how long, with a link to the call, before dialing again.
Dialer: leads at the attempt cap are closed by the server; the dialer no longer retries a Lost save every minute. STOP during a pause no longer hangs up an inbound call.

Call Coach: always asks "where did you hear about us?" and puts the answer under SOURCE in the note. Publish shows it next to the lead source and pre-picks referral, repeat, truck, yard sign, door knock, realtor, Facebook, Angi, Yelp or Modernize when the caller names one (Hunter).
